USMEF: Contracara (pulpa blanca), con cuete = Bottom round or Gooseneck; the outside muscle. Subdivides into cuete (eye of round), copete/talon (heel of round), contracara (outside round flat).
Bare 'Pulpa' means pulpa blanca - confirmed by domain review. MERGE with Pulpa Blanca.
Domain review: arrachera = OUTSIDE skirt; entrana = INSIDE skirt (IMPS 121D). Both are skirts, so a USDA inside-skirt series can be paired here, noting they are different IMPS codes and price levels.

USMEF: Pulpa negra (Cara) = Top (Inside) round; the inside muscle. Confirmed separate from Pulpa Blanca by test: 1162 same-day co-reports, price correlation 0.81, Pulpa Negra dearer by 25.4 MXN/kg on average - consistent with top round outpricing bottom round.
